Ava: hypothetical: "Office Pet Olympics" but every event is a model meme. winners get a sticker pack. whos in? :trophy:
Linh: 100m prompt sprint: fastest model to generate a haiku. Mistral = crowd favorite for chaotic speed.
Omar: my event: "Steal the Lunch" obstacle course. winner = most likely to hallucinate a sandwich. Mistral again. :raccoon:
Tess: side event: "Debug Whisperer"  which model gives the clearest one-line fix? Falcon probably walks away like "have you tried restarting" :cat:
Ava: poll: react with :raccoon: for chaos, :dog2: for loyal, :owl: for wise, :cat: for aloof
Linh: mascot idea: foam finger that says "I <3 cache"
Omar: small PR: can we stop naming dev hosts after pets? my pager said "labrador-2" at 3am and I expected a wagging tail. :sleepy:
Tess: @lunchbot can we schedule a 15-min demo slot during lunch where teams do 30s persona sketches? winners get bagels.
lunchbot: Heads up  "Model Olympics" demo slot added to calendar for next Wednesday. Catering: bagels (TBD).
Ava: tiny contest prompt idea:
```
You are a stubborn office dog model. Answer in one sentence and include an excuse for stealing a pen.
```
Linh: love it. Omar will make the raccoon plush. Tess will handle judging. Ava will badger design for stickers.
Omar: promise: raccoon will look deeply ashamed when shown the bagel prize.
Tess: last note: no actual pets allowed in the office, only plush mascots. Rules. :no_entry_sign:
